violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the 3-bay sink room/mop sink room was removed (per the PIC, plumbing repairs/replacement recently conducted). Hand sink is to be replaced as previously approved by RIDOH CFP. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026

Food items in the open-air cooler were observed held at 41-44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC to ensure food items are rotated and stored back from the front edge of shelving. Per the PIC, a new ticket to be submitted for unit adjustment/repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities were observed in need of repair: - Several floor tiles around the soda island were observed cracked/chipped and in need of replacement. - The wall covering in the 3-bay sink/mop sink room was observed to be cracked, chipped, and/or delaminating. Wall coverings in spaces subject to moisture are to be maintained smooth/durable/nonabsorbent/easily cleanable. Physical facilities are to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2027

Dish was observed in hand-washing sink located in 3-bay sink area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed dish from hand washing sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (QT) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2025

The area behind the wall of reach-in freezers was observed to have an accumulation of droppings and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean and to aid in the current pest control program. New Violation. Correct By: 05/11/2024
